reviews.quote: Apple also includes Wi-Fi 7 as well as much faster PCIe 5.0 SSDs (same chip tested in the 16-inch chassis)
exceptional build quality... all-aluminum unibody (same chassis, M5 model tested)

praises: 2TB of PCIe 5.0 storage holds full 4K/8K shoot catalogs on-device at SSD speeds (NBC benchmarks)
M5 Pro's ~20% CPU / 30-50% GPU gain over M4 Pro shows up in every export benchmark (NBC)
Thunderbolt 5 for fast docks and external RAID (NBC)
Very quiet in most scenarios even under sustained exports (NBC)
complaints: +$750 CAD for the second terabyte — storage upgrades are more expensive than ever (NBC and Tom's Hardware)
Prices are still high, especially when you add upgrades (NBC con)
Still no SD Express support in the card reader (NBC con)
RAM and SSD soldered — you must buy capacity up front
Same 5-year-old chassis; a redesign is overdue (NBC and Tom's Hardware)

design_philosophy: Apple sells capacity, not slots: this tier bundles the M5 Pro's multicore muscle with double the soldered flash for creators who keep working libraries local. It is the 'travel-light with your whole project on board' configuration.
rating_notes: Ratings inferred from NBC's 92.3% M5 Pro review (16-inch chassis) as with the 1TB sibling; +0.2 creative_work for the 2TB working-library capacity. Sentiment synthesized from pro reviews — Reddit API blocked (403).
